craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta of landing — rest, fulfillment, no-other-standing; autonomy dawning mid-proof. Seal: last word shows — shining shows itself showing; song ends inside its own verb. Rupture: limit-dwelling, then nothing past shining. Rejected: (a) appears (L2) → killed: L3 frozen + shows is active. (b) expanding limit-dwelling → killed: paryantavartin kept packed (row 2 pressure). Read aloud: AND in I-KNOW-ing … NO-thing IN-ert PAST-shin-ing SHOWS.

lines: And in I-knowing whose self is non-parting grasp, limit-dwelling —
l4.sanskrit_cite: na cāpy avyatirekātmavimarśātmany ahaṃvidi bhāti paryantavartinyāṃ bhāsanād adhikaṃ jaḍam

reads_against.argmap: What shows at the limit? → Seal of the passage: at the limit, shining exhausts the inert; one knower flashes, world outshone and reabsorbed.
c1_essence: What never stood cannot stand another: consciousness fits itself to this and I, orders inert selves by double certainty, and completes severed grasping in self-rest (vv10-15).
The same self twofold — breath-bound atom, unbroken whole — gathers in one continuous end-ground where nothing shows more inert than shining (vv16-18).
